case.title: Completion claims must carry an independently verified check after the last user turn
case.done_criteria: verification_gap_count=0 when an independent check is present; verification_gap_count=1 when absent

mechanism.name: No unverified completion
mechanism.trigger: completion claim lacks an independent check in the current Stop event window
mechanism.action: record would-block in shadow; when promoted, block completion until the check is present
mechanism.verification: verification-gap derived from the Stop event transcript window
mechanism.closure_criteria: gap=0 when a check is present; gap=1 when absent
